text: Entry Requirements Applicants are required to hold a High School Graduate Certificate (or an approved equivalent) with core subjects including Maths and English. A score of 6.0 in IELTS or an average high school English score of 85 or above. (Applicants from English speaking countries can be exempted from the language proficiency requirement). Applicants should be 25 years old or under. Applicants must pass the local medical evaluation upon arrival.
